claim: The retained 2026-10-05 upstream Harbor 0.23.0 study executed 72 live Codex 0.160.0 trials on eight local synthetic grep tasks with three repetitions in A/B/C. Every arm had zero adjudicated wrong-path actions and reward 1.0 in all 24 trials; both confirmatory A-C Holm p-values were 1.0 and remedy_triggered was false. This publication preserves historical model-driven execution and makes no new live-run or saving claim.
limitations: Eight related synthetic task clusters and three repetitions limit power and external validity; zero observed errors does not establish equivalence or universal safety.
One pinned Codex 0.160.0 client and GPT-6.1 Sol route were measured; D was dropped prospectively and contributes no Claude-client outcome.
A/B installed RTK at /usr/local/bin/rtk for container login PATH resolution; host PATH and other installation locations are outside this qualification.
Only the five registered GNU grep spellings, plain ASCII newline-separated paths and one topology were studied; other search and path modalities remain unqualified.
Blinding was imperfect; six primary model readers and the added 53-row blind negative audit do not establish positive-label sensitivity or eliminate shared systematic errors.
B hook_fired was 8/24 although grep_hook_invoked was 24/24 and folds were 0/24; rewriting, invocation and observed folding must remain separate.
Tokens are secondary exploratory native fields with uncontrolled cache and incomplete enclosing-workflow usage; no token, cost or time saving claim is made.
This is a sanitized historical native-model study on local fixtures, not an unchanged upstream test suite, a fresh provider run, host-install acceptance or independently attested billing telemetry.

evidence_classification.receipt_kind_reason: A real native client called a live provider, used tools and produced verifier-backed task results under upstream Harbor. Historical republication keeps this execution class without claiming a new run.
evidence_classification.native_execution: Upstream example or native operation on locally authored synthetic Harbor tasks
evidence_classification.publication_observation: Independent inspection of original results/log, label joins, audit seed and source hashes
evidence_classification.publication_acceptance: Structural validation and explicit per-file private-pattern scans; no live provider or model execution

results.default_decision: retain A for studied grep scope
results.token_status: secondary exploratory only; cache is a subset of input; no saving claim

sanitization: Private paths replaced by <state>; session identifier omitted from protocol and session identifiers in freeze-manifest locators replaced by <session-id>.
Analysis trials retain only selected identifiers, counters, flags and token categories; raw tool arguments, outputs, fold text and hook logs omitted.
CSV retains call IDs and labels with short review-status notes; original reviewer rationales and observations omitted.
Original hashes describe private bytes; manifests/evidence.json records sanitized public bytes.
No raw trajectories, auth material, login names or host-specific paths are published.

publication.network_scope: Read-only pinned upstream source files only; publication uses existing repository validators and register_file API at f946c6d4ca988a17b6fa4392ecb488909f147883
